API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS)NSS Resource Update NSS Server
NSS Resource Update NSS Server
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssServers/:nssId

Updates an NSS server based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
nssId
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the NSS ID

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

NSS server information

id
int32

System-generated identifier for the NSS server

name
string

NSS server name

status
string

Enables or disables the status of the NSS server

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED, DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_PROVIDER, NOT_PROVISIONED_IN_SERVICE_PROVIDER, IN_TRIAL]

state
string

The health of the NSS server

Possible values: [UNHEALTHY, HEALTHY, UNKNOWN]

icapSvrId
int32

The ICAP server ID

type
string

The server type. The NSS for Web type is selected by default.

Possible values: [NONE, SOFTWARE_AA_FLAG, NSS_FOR_WEB, NSS_FOR_FIREWALL, VZEN, VZEN_SME, VZEN_SMLB, PINNED_NSS, MD5_CAPABLE, ADP, ZIRSVR, NSS_FOR_ZPA]

Responses
​
200
401
404
500

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated identifier of the NSS server based on the software platform

name
string

NSS server name

status
string

Enables or disables the status of the NSS server

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED, DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_PROVIDER, NOT_PROVISIONED_IN_SERVICE_PROVIDER, IN_TRIAL]

state
string

The health of the NSS server

Possible values: [UNHEALTHY, HEALTHY, UNKNOWN]

icapSvrId
int32

The ICAP server ID
